net_hits.finding: The net-hit path requires the hit-by-net query to pass and the hit counter to reach 3; the below-threshold path arms the 60-timer action and returns to the normal AI route. Outdoor additionally requires HitMainPlayer and HasAcquaintanceship before entering cHit/Hit. NNPC_Talk_Force:Hit then chooses one of three mutually exclusive random branches; only action sites 21, 32, or 33 can subtract -3, and each is reached through CheckNpcLook case 0 and NoAcquaintance_Chk. The helper exits when HasAcquaintanceship is OFF. Thus one Hit-entry invocation can execute at most one of these three -3 actions, while a later thresholded hit sequence may repeat it after hit state is reset. The same flow has four other -3 actions in Push and +5 in Flea; these are separate entries. All configured callback values are forwarded unchanged in the 72/72 native action test.
limits: The AI transition bodies are not exercised as an end-to-end native hit simulation.
The timer handler is tested natively with synthetic context; update cadence and the counter incrementer remain unknown.
A net hit alone does not prove a Friendship loss: the threshold, AI route, acquaintance/look checks, and selected dialogue branch all matter.

neglect_and_caps.first_talk_of_day: 0xc84240 increments TalkCountToday and awards Friendship only when its resulting value is 1; the delta is min(ContinuousTalkDays, 3), as pseudocode evidence.
neglect_and_caps.missed_talk: The day-change reset helpers clear ContinuousTalkDays when the prior TalkCountToday is zero in the applicable mode. This removes the streak bonus; no direct Friendship decrement is shown on that path.
neglect_and_caps.field_table: EventFlagsNpcMemoryParam sets Friendship default 25/max 255 and ContinuousTalkDays default 0/max 7. These are field bounds, not an aggregate daily Friendship cap.
neglect_and_caps.milestone_flag: NNPC_Talk_General:PresentAvailable_Chk uses FriendshipBecomeAcqHToday and FriendshipBecomeAcqH to gate ReceivedFirstPresent; these flags are not a writer-level point cap.
neglect_and_caps.quest_timeout: NNPC_Quest_Delivery_TimeOver configures -1, -2, or -3 according to HasDeliveryItem and HasOpenedDeliveryItem query branches; this is a quest timeout penalty, not passive neglect decay.

calc_minus_three_branches: First conditional return stores -3 when an async task result is greater than 2. The task result lives at wrapper+0x20 and is read only once its status at +0x50 equals 2; the task/worker result enum is not named.

Second conditional return stores -3 when any of six descriptor category checks matches ItemKind ordinal codes 0x3a=Trash, 0x62=LostQuestDust, 0x65=TreasureQuestDust, 0x5f=JohnnyQuestDust, 0x31=TurnipExpired, or 0x2a=Weed. Helper 0xb9cb60 maps descriptor+0x10 through the ItemParam.ItemKind u16 category map before comparison; these codes are not ItemKind row UniqueIDs or EventFlags UniqueIDs.
daily_candidate.other_caller_caveat: 0xac0200 also has direct caller 0xabfcf0; that function has no indexed direct caller, so the writer is not proven to be day-change-exclusive.
